numActive.description: Number of current active (e.g. borrowed) connections

numIdle.description: Number of idle connections in the pool

maxTotal.description: Maximum combined total of active/idle connections.

maxIdle.description: Maximum number of idle connections in the pool.

minIdle.description: Minimum number of idle connections maintained in the pool.

maxWaitMillis.description: Maximum amount of time to wait for an available connection before throw an exception.

minEvictableIdleTimeMillis.description: Minimum amount of time a connection will be idle before it can be evicted.
